explanation: A variable with no default is required — the caller must supply it every time the module is used. A variable with default = {} is optional because Terraform uses the default when the caller omits it. Setting bucket_name to default = "" makes it optional (empty string is still a value), and giving tags no default makes it required, which is the opposite of what is needed.

Outputs are the only supported way to get information about resources inside a module. The root module accesses them via module.<name>[<key>].<output_name>. aws_s3_bucket.main.arn is only in scope inside the storage module itself, not in the root. File paths and var references are not valid ways to read module outputs.

A precondition in an output block is evaluated when Terraform reads that output's value — during apply (or plan when the value is known). It is not a validate-only check, it is not run at variable-parsing time before planning, and it applies to normal plan/apply operations, not only import.
